profile.headline: Software Development Engineer - Full Stack at Amazon
profile.geoLocationName: Ridgefield Park, New Jersey, United States
profile.summary: Efficient, reliable & highly motivated Computer Science student with over 5+ years of experience in computer related fields obtained from self-learning, extra-curricular classes and self-assigned projects. Known for great problem solving skills, great understanding of OOP and establishing creative strategies for optimizing internal operations. I enjoy applying the principles of software engineer to provide solutions to complex problems. Mostly focused on web development.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer - Full Stack
positions.description:
• Designed and implemented multiple large-scale Apache Spark data pipelines
processing multi-terabyte datasets daily to power AI-driven ad sourcing for off-
Amazon display advertising
• Collaborated cross-functionally with data scientists to develop, execute, and
analyze controlled ad experiments, in 3P Websites, Twitch and IMDB, providing
metrics and insights that influenced multi-million dollar revenue-impacting
product decisions
• Played a hybrid engineering and product role to identify system-level
dependencies and orchestrate cross-team changes required to support new ad
product features
• Optimized performance and reliability of ETL workflows on AWS EMR,
integrating data from S3, DynamoDB, and various internal services to produce
high-quality training datasets for ML models
• Led the enablement of iOS mobile ad supply on Twitch, integrating with internal
ad delivery systems and expanding ad reach, resulting in a 50% increase in
mobile ad revenue
• Partnered with scientists, product managers, and stakeholders to translate
ambiguous product requirements into well-scoped, technically feasible data
engineering projects
positions.insights: Skills: Apache Spark · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Big Data · Machine Learning · Microservices

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States

positions.title: Lead Developer
positions.description:
• Designed, developed, tested and deployed web applications using PHP, MySQL, HTML, CSS and WordPress as a Content Management System.
• Documented the use and maintenance of all software and programs.
• Collaborated with staff and teams to develop, format and deploy content. 
• Fixed bugs, troubleshoot and resolved problems. 
• Assumed ownership of code throughout development, staging, testing and production.

company.name: Louis Stokes Alliance for Minority Participation(LSAMP)

positions.title: Computer Science Tutor
positions.description:
• Developed and implemented lesson plans to facilitate student learning in Java, Data Structures and Assembly Language.
• Facilitated students to comprehend and apply the newly learned content intelligently.
• Assisted students to become independent and collaborative learners.

company.name: Research Foundation of The City University of New York

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
•	Participated in 10-wk residential program for students interested in graduate study.
•	Attended week-long short course in statistics and R Studio software.
•	Assisted in development of an unsupervised learning algorithm for data collection in wireless sensor networks using Python.
•	Analyzed data from Hubbard Brook Experimental Forest dataset.
•	Participated as a peer evaluator during weekly student research presentations.
•	Presented research at campus-wide symposium (July 2014).

positions.title: Teacher Assistant
positions.description:
*Assisted a professor with classroom activities.
*Tutor students in small groups or individually.
*Motivated students to follow a career path and accomplish their career goals.
*Maintained discipline of students in the absence of the teacher.
*Maintained clerical records and arranged required reports.
*Performed a variety of non-instructional duties.

positions.title: IT Manager
positions.description:
*Partnered with fellow colleagues to create a LEDTV projection system using HDMI matrices and HDMI cables with Ethernet to prevent signal loss.
*Implemented a guest WiFi network to prevent overload of network traffic on current WiFi networks, with limited IP address lease time and number of users per session.
*Replaced several workstations within a client/server environment, connecting each workstation to server domain.
*Solved day-to-day user issues such as printer connectivity and hardware malfunctions.
*Reconstructed office workstation by replacing hardware and software, in an effort to improve episode production rate and job performance.

positions.title: Video Producer
positions.description:
*Developed a computer software system using JAVA and MySQL that assisted the video editors to keep track of the tasks that needed to be accomplished in daily basics.
*Edited and delivered five or more television shows weekly to multiple TV networks.
*Raised over $900 in sales through rapid reproduction of TV recordings.
*Recorded TV programs inside and outside local congregation for events and concerts.
*Coordinated event recordings with colleagues and peers to ensure delegation of responsibilities.
